title: Search a research source
summary: Searches a research source for items on a topic and lists up to eight with their id, year and a line of summary. The source is arXiv unless the agent or the person names another (Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex, PubMed, Hacker News, or a site from My sources).
whenToUse: Use first when the person wants a paper, a study or a post on a topic. Pick the source that fits the topic when more than one is offered.

arguments.name: query
arguments.description: Search words, such as 'on-device language models iPhone'

arguments.name: source
arguments.description: Which source to search: one of the ids this agent lists, such as arxiv or semanticscholar. Leave empty for the agent's first source.

example: Find a recent paper about speech recognition on phones
_note: Phase AV.0: the id stays `searchPapers` so the packs and the tool name the planner learned keep working; the source is now an argument, not a fact in Swift (the AG.2 verb searched arXiv only).
